title: How Ravana Actually Died
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6(96-97) (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.107-108)

captions.instagram:
Did Rama really shoot Ravana in the navel?

Many of us grew up with the scene where Vibhishana tells Rama that Ravana keeps nectar in his navel, and Rama's arrow dries it up. In Valmiki's Ramayana, Rama does cut off Ravana's head again and again, and it grows back, a hundred times. But the one who reminds Rama is Matali, Indra's charioteer. The Brahmastra strikes Ravana's chest and pierces his heart. The navel nectar and the thirty-one arrows come from Goswami Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas, written in the 16th century. Both are told with devotion. Valmiki simply tells it differently.

Which version did you grow up with: the navel arrow, or the arrow to the heart? 👇

📜 Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6(96-97) (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.107-108)

captions.youtube_description:
Did Rama really shoot Ravana in the navel?

Many of us grew up with the scene where Vibhishana tells Rama that Ravana keeps nectar in his navel, and Rama's arrow dries it up. In Valmiki's Ramayana, Rama does cut off Ravana's head again and again, and it grows back, a hundred times. But the one who reminds Rama is Matali, Indra's charioteer. The Brahmastra strikes Ravana's chest and pierces his heart. The navel nectar and the thirty-one arrows come from Goswami Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas, written in the 16th century. Both are told with devotion. Valmiki simply tells it differently.

Which version did you grow up with: the navel arrow, or the arrow to the heart? 👇

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6(96-97) (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.107-108)
Verses:
• Rama severs Ravana's head with an arrow; an identical head appears at once — 6.96.20-21
• A hundred heads are severed one after another, yet Ravana's end is not seen — 6.96.22-24
• Matali, Indra's charioteer, reminds Rama and urges the Brahmastra — 6.97.1-3
• The arrow falls on Ravana's chest and pierces his heart — 6.97.16-17
• No navel, nectar, or secret from Vibhishana in Valmiki's account of the death — 6.96-6.97 (chapters, read)
• In the Ramcharitmanas, Vibhishana tells Rama that nectar dwells in Ravana's navel — Ramcharitmanas, Lanka Kand 101.3
• In the Ramcharitmanas, Rama looses thirty-one arrows; one dries up the navel — Ramcharitmanas, Lanka Kand doha 102, 103.1

verify_note: CE 6.96.20-21: Rama severs Ravana's head with a razor arrow; an identical head appears at once. 6.96.22-24: again and again, a hundred heads of equal splendour are severed, yet Ravana's end is not seen. 6.97.1-3: Matali reminds Rama ('why prolong this, as if you do not know?') and urges the Brahmastra; Rama takes up the blazing arrow. 6.97.16-17: it falls on Ravana's chest and pierces his heart. 6.97.20-21: bow falls, he falls lifeless. No navel, no nectar, no secret from Vibhishana in CE 6.96-97; vulgate 6.108 also has the arrow tear through the heart. Ramcharitmanas Lanka Kand 101.3: Vibhishana tells Rama nectar dwells in Ravana's navel; doha 102 and 103.1: Rama looses 31 arrows, one dries up the navel. Ramcharitmanas: Tulsidas, 16th century (begun 1574 CE).
